note: Facts plus a look. Radii are the published ring radii (km, about Jupiter's centre, in its equator plane). Colours and opacities are Planetary Explorer's Jupiter ring bands (the owner's own project, src/entities/jupiter.ts ringSystem at donor commit 84f8d3ee77aff47f2f36f157b62b97dce7176b95), lifted as they are. The donor placed its bands at 1.6-3.2 planet radii; the owner chose the real distances instead (O-025 Decision 7, 'Your look, real distances'). The faint Thebe extension (221,900-280,000 km) has no donor band and is not drawn.
